GametxtResource.GameStory:
Be quiet!
She can hear anything! If you drop something, it will makes a sound! 
You can try hiding under the bed and in cupboards to avoid her!
Press 'Continue' to start the game.
You only have 5 days.

1.Get out of here!
2.You only have 5 days.
3.Be quiet, she can hear everything!
4.Granny is crazy!

DayTipConfig.txt: Tips: I heard that Granny's spider likes to eat meat.
Tips:Birds are attracted to food
Tips:Granny can hear everything, be careful!
Tips: Need to escape in a limited number of tries
Tips: There is more than one lock on Granny's gate
Tips: A gun can completely immobilize Granny!
Tips:Shooting Anesthetic needle with Crossbow can make Granny fall asleep
Tips:Granny: I hate Pepper
Tips:Pepper is locked up in the stairwell
Tips: The Crossbow is in a small room in the 2nd floor passage
Tips:Gun can be assembled at the Weapon table in the Garage
Tips:To assemble the gun, you need to gather 3 parts
Tips: After gathering the missing parts, you can start the car in the garage
Tips:You need to refuel the car before starting it
Tips:The car hood can be opened
Tips:The car trunk can be opened
Tip: You can look for keys in drawers and other places
Tips: Watermelon can be cut, but you need to find a place to cut it first
Tips: Use a hammer to knock down the assembled wooden door
Tips:Use pliers to cut off electrical wires
Tips:Some floors are so old that they make noise when stepped on.
Tips:There seems to be something under the well in the yard. It needs to be fished out with a bucket.
Tips:There seems to be something in the dog house. Find the dog house key and open it to take a look.
Tips:You can hide in the cabinet, but don't let Granny see it
Tips:You can hide under the bed, but don't let Granny see you
Tips:You can hide in the box. Granny can't bend down and can't see you in the box.
Tips:Grandma can't squat, so in some places Granny can't pass
Tips:Granny will send people to jail, but she won't go to jail herself
Tips:There is a crib in the small room on the 3rd floor. Maybe there is some secret about Granny hidden in it.
Tips:Frost trap can be used on Granny to slow down her speed
Tips:Granny is too old to climb over the window
Tips:Granny will move faster when chasing people, so run quickly!
